articles.title: Sanjay Dutt at 67: Six Meals a Day and a Weakness for Biryani
articles.excerpt: As Bollywood's 'Baba' marks his 67th birthday, a look at the disciplined six-meal diet that keeps him camera-ready — and the cheat-day indulgences he refuses to give up.
articles.nri_angle: Dutt's diet bridges Indian culinary heritage — his mother Nargis's rogan josh, Mughlai kebabs, and biryani — with modern wellness practices familiar to diaspora audiences balancing desi food traditions with healthy eating.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dahi Wale Tinde: The Yogurt Curry That Makes Humble Tinda Irresistible
articles.excerpt: This North Indian summer staple transforms the often-dismissed apple gourd into a tangy, spiced yogurt curry that pairs perfectly with roti or paratha.
articles.nri_angle: Tinda is available seasonally at Indian grocery stores in the US, UK, and Canada, typically between June and September, making this a timely summer recipe for diaspora kitchens.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AI Calorie-Tracking Apps Undercount by Hundreds of Calories, NIH Study Finds
articles.excerpt: Photo-based nutrition apps underestimated meal calories by 250 to 345 on average, with fat miscounted by about 30 grams — and the errors are worse for mixed dishes common in Indian cuisine.
articles.image_caption: A new NIH study finds AI-powered calorie-tracking apps significantly undercount daily intake
articles.nri_angle: AI calorie-tracking apps perform worst on mixed Asian and Indian dishes like biryani and dal, making them unreliable for health-conscious diaspora users relying on these tools.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bengaluru Restaurants Set August 15 Deadline to Quit Swiggy and Zomato
articles.excerpt: Restaurant owners in India's tech capital are giving food delivery platforms a month to lower commissions or face a mass delisting, joining a nationwide revolt that has already seen entire towns pull their menus from the duopoly.
articles.nri_angle: Indians abroad who use Swiggy and Zomato to send meals to family or order ahead before visits may find fewer restaurants on the platforms, while diaspora-funded restaurant investments face new questions about the sustainability of platform-dependent business models.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gujarat Wins GI Tag for Unjha Cumin, Reigniting Rivalry With Rajasthan Over India's Most Prized Spice
articles.excerpt: The Geographical Indication tag for Unjha jeera gives Gujarat exclusive branding rights over cumin, even as Rajasthan's Thar Desert produces what experts call the world's most flavorful variety.
articles.nri_angle: For millions of Indians abroad who rely on jeera as a kitchen staple, the GI tag battle between Gujarat and Rajasthan could reshape pricing and authenticity claims for cumin sold in international markets.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Asma Khan Challenges Fine Dining's Double Standard on Indian Cuisine
articles.excerpt: The Darjeeling Express chef and Netflix star pushes back against the persistent perception that Indian food doesn't deserve a place at the fine-dining table.
articles.nri_angle: Khan's fight against the undervaluation of Indian cuisine reflects a broader pattern diaspora communities recognize — South Asian cultural contributions consumed but not fully respected in Western societies.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Biryani Lounge in Reading Seeks Licence to Serve Food Until 4am
articles.excerpt: The Hyderabadi biryani specialist on Wokingham Road has applied to Reading Borough Council for a late-night refreshment licence covering Monday to Saturday.
articles.image_caption: Hyderabadi biryani. The Biryani Lounge in Reading specialises in Hyderabadi biryani and South Indian dishes.
articles.nri_angle: Addresses the limited late-night Indian dining options for South Asian communities in southern England, where most Indian restaurants close by 11pm.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Seven Historic Indian Palaces and Forts Now Serving Fine Cuisine
articles.excerpt: From Jodhpur's sandstone havelis to Mumbai's converted ice factories, India's architectural landmarks are finding new life as dining destinations that pair heritage preservation with regional gastronomy.
articles.nri_angle: Heritage restaurants offer diaspora members an immersive way to reconnect with India's architectural and culinary traditions during visits home.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Did Draupadi Really Invent Pani Puri? The Myth, the History and Why It Matters
articles.excerpt: A beloved Mahabharata legend credits Draupadi with inventing India's most iconic street snack, but food historians point to a more complex origin in ancient Magadha.
articles.image_caption: Plates of pani puri, the beloved Indian street snack of crisp hollow shells filled with spiced water, potato and chickpea. The dish traces its origins to centuries-old culinary traditions across the subcontinent.
articles.nri_angle: Pani puri is one of the most recreated Indian dishes abroad and a sensory anchor to home for the diaspora — its origin story captures the ingenuity at the heart of Indian cooking.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Paneer Pakora: The Ultimate Monsoon Snack You Can Make in 30 Minutes
articles.excerpt: Crispy, golden, and impossibly satisfying — this classic Indian fritter is the only recipe you need when the rains roll in and the chai is brewing.
articles.image_caption: Golden paneer pakoras arranged on a plate, ready to serve. The deep-fried cottage cheese fritters are a staple monsoon snack across India, best enjoyed hot with chai and green chutney.
articles.nri_angle: For Indians abroad, paneer pakora is comfort food that bridges the distance — a taste of home that transforms any rainy afternoon into a familiar ritual of chai and fritters.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: How to Make Crispy Aloo Kulcha at Home Without a Tandoor
articles.excerpt: A step-by-step guide to making the iconic Amritsari stuffed flatbread on a tawa, in the oven, or in an air fryer — no clay oven required.
articles.image_caption: Aloo kulcha, a popular North Indian stuffed bread traditionally cooked in a tandoor
articles.nri_angle: Aloo kulcha adapts easily to diaspora kitchens using a cast-iron tawa, oven, or air fryer with ingredients now widely available at mainstream supermarkets worldwide.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian Food Fair Returns to Salt Lake City's Liberty Park on August 15 for Independence Day Celebration
articles.excerpt: The annual community event organized by the Indian Association of Utah will feature traditional cuisine, cultural performances, and Independence Day festivities in one of the state's largest Indian-American gatherings.
articles.nri_angle: An annual anchor event for Utah's Indian-American community, drawing families from across the Intermountain West for Independence Day celebrations and community connection.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Onion Tomato Chutney: The 20-Minute South Indian Staple Every Kitchen Needs
articles.excerpt: A simple, balanced condiment made with equal parts onions and tomatoes, this chutney pairs with everything from crispy dosa to steamed rice.
articles.image_caption: Onion tomato chutney, a staple condiment in South Indian cuisine, pairs with dosa, idli, and rice dishes
articles.nri_angle: A pantry staple for South Indian families worldwide, this chutney is one of the first recipes many diaspora cooks learn to recreate abroad.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Why Diet Coke Prices in India Have Jumped More Than 10 Percent
articles.excerpt: An aluminium can shortage triggered by the Iran conflict and tighter import regulations has forced Coca-Cola to replace its popular 300-ml Diet Coke can with pricier, larger imports — and some consumers are paying nearly triple.
articles.nri_angle: Indian diaspora members visiting home or sending care packages may find Diet Coke harder to source and significantly pricier than before.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mangalorean Chicken Ghee Roast: The Indulgent Dish Nutritionists Actually Endorse
articles.excerpt: Born in a Kundapur restaurant kitchen in 1957, this fiery coastal Karnataka classic packs 34 grams of protein per serving — and modern science is catching up to what Ayurveda always knew about ghee.
articles.image_caption: Mangalorean chicken ghee roast, a rich and spicy dish made with aromatic spices and generous amounts of ghee
articles.nri_angle: For Indians abroad craving authentic coastal Karnataka flavors, this protein-rich Mangalorean chicken ghee roast can be recreated with widely available ingredients and offers a nutritionist-backed indulgence.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: How Chef Harpal Singh Sokhi Built Karigari Into a Culinary Movement
articles.excerpt: The celebrity chef behind 'Namak Shamak' has expanded his restaurant Karigari to 11 outlets across India, blending regional traditions with modern dining.
articles.nri_angle: Karigari represents a growing trend of chef-driven Indian restaurants that treat the cuisine as a serious culinary tradition, mirroring diaspora expectations for refined Indian dining.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Chana Dal Vada: The Crispy South Indian Snack Perfect for Monsoon Evenings
articles.excerpt: This classic South Indian fritter, made with soaked chana dal and aromatic spices, is the ideal tea-time companion when the rains arrive.
articles.image_caption: Crispy chana dal vada, a popular South Indian snack made from ground chana dal and spices.
articles.nri_angle: Chana dal vada requires no special ingredients unavailable abroad — chana dal and basic spices are found at any Indian grocery store worldwide.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Rujuta Diwekar's Lauki Paneer Tikki Offers a Clever Fix for Fussy Young Eaters
articles.excerpt: The celebrity nutritionist's bottle gourd and paneer tikki recipe transforms one of India's most shunned vegetables into a crispy, protein-rich snack that children actually want to eat.
articles.nri_angle: The tikki format bridges traditional Indian nutrition with Western snack culture, helping diaspora parents introduce bottle gourd to children raised in Western food environments.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: New Jersey Indian Grocery Store Goes Viral as Parval Deal Sparks Sabzi Mandi Frenzy
articles.excerpt: A $1.99-per-pound discount on pointed gourd drew hundreds of shoppers to a new Indian supermarket, with viral videos earning the store the nickname "American Sabzi Mandi."
articles.image_caption: Pointed gourd (parval), a staple vegetable in South Asian cooking, sparked a viral moment at a New Jersey Indian grocery store
articles.nri_angle: The viral grand opening underscores how Indian diaspora communities in the US maintain strong demand for familiar vegetables and regional grocery products, driving the rapid expansion of Indian supermarkets across the country.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: From Peels to Plates: How India's Zero-Waste Kitchen Traditions Are Finding New Global Relevance
articles.excerpt: Long before sustainability became a buzzword, Indian home cooks mastered the art of using every part of every ingredient. Modern chefs and food scientists are now paying attention.
articles.nri_angle: Indian diaspora families often carry these zero-waste cooking traditions with them, and many are now finding their home practices align with the global sustainability movement.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Flipkart to Launch Food Delivery in Coming Weeks, Says Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy
articles.excerpt: The Walmart-backed e-commerce giant is set to enter India's $9 billion food delivery market, leveraging its Flipkart Minutes quick-commerce infrastructure as part of an aggressive pre-IPO diversification push.
articles.image_caption: Flipkart Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy at a company event. The e-commerce giant is set to enter India's food delivery market in the coming weeks, challenging the Zomato-Swiggy duopoly.
articles.nri_angle: Flipkart's entry into food delivery reshapes the investment landscape for NRIs tracking Indian tech stocks, with potential margin compression for publicly listed Zomato and Swiggy.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian Restaurants Now Dominate NYC's Most Coveted Reservation Lists
articles.excerpt: From Michelin-starred Semma to the 140-seat London import Ambassadors Clubhouse, Indian dining has displaced omakase bars and steakhouses as New York's toughest ticket.
articles.image_caption: Indian restaurants across New York City now command the most competitive reservation lists in the city, displacing omakase counters and exclusive steakhouses. Establishments like Semma, Ambassadors Clubhouse and Bungalow have turned regional Indian cuisine into Manhattan's most sought-after dining experience.
articles.nri_angle: The reservation boom signals that Indian cuisine has earned permanent standing at the top tier of New York's dining hierarchy, a milestone of cultural recognition for the city's large Indian American community.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Michelin-Starred Indienne Brings Indian Fine Dining to New York's Hudson Yards
articles.excerpt: Chef Sujan Sarkar's acclaimed Chicago restaurant opens a 34-seat New York outpost with three nine-course tasting menus, marking his return to the city where he first made his name.
articles.image_caption: Indienne New York occupies a 34-seat dining room inside Henry Hall, a luxury residential tower in Hudson Yards. Chef Sujan Sarkar's restaurant earned a Michelin star at its Chicago original within its first year of operation.
articles.nri_angle: Kolkata-born chef Sujan Sarkar's expansion to New York with a Michelin-starred Indian tasting menu restaurant represents a milestone for Indian cuisine's presence at the highest tier of American fine dining.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
